scope: Three source root causes; generated artifacts, suppressions, dependency versions and unrelated workspace changes left untouched.

rootCauses.name: Settings/page synchronization with live preview
rootCauses.impact: On navigation, children first rendered the old page/settings before an effect corrected them. A regression reproduced the stale child render.
rootCauses.fix: Keep page/settings together as preview-owned state. A converging render guard reconciles changed inputs atomically before children render. Preserve same-UUID state, null-page clearing and preview bridge lifecycle. A keyed reset would unnecessarily remount children; deriving entirely from props would discard preview edits.
rootCauses.tests: Changed-UUID and null-page transitions expose only current data to children. Same UUID retains state. Existing bridge tests cover matching/unrelated events, page/global preview updates, reloads, cleanup and cancellation of pending bridge creation.

rootCauses.name: Snackbar visibility synchronization
rootCauses.impact: Display/scroll changes exposed old visibility to children before corrective effects. Regression reproduced the extra stale render. This can briefly show a notice that should already be hidden.
rootCauses.fix: Use a converging render guard and a pure visibility calculation for configuration/scroll changes; keep timer and manual dismissal state. A stable server snapshot keeps SSR and initial hydration closed. Cookie dismissal is state; an Effect Event reads current cookie status without restarting the opening timer on acceptance.
rootCauses.tests: Show/hide on scroll, immediate configuration visibility, dismissal across unrelated updates, delayed open/close, cancellation of pending timers, cookie writes/hiding, closed server output and hydration preserving the DOM without recoverable errors.

rootCauses.name: Infinite-scroll self-triggered page updates
rootCauses.impact: When visible, changing page retriggered the same effect indefinitely. A bounded regression reproduced the repeated update loop. No active internal callers were found, so current production impact is unestablished.
rootCauses.fix: Use a functional state updater and depend only on observer visibility. Advance one page per false-to-true transition instead of triggering another update from the page change.
rootCauses.tests: Initial page, first visibility entry, unrelated rerender, exit/reentry and end-of-collection hasMore/data behavior. Test includes a render limit so the original loop fails safely.

recipeReview: Fetched with no-cache curl and read validation predicates. Provider/Snackbar require partially adjustable state because preview events, timers and user events own updates. Applied the recipe's explicitly permitted converging guarded-render adjustment. Infinite scroll uses the prescribed latest-state updater; removing page from dependencies stops the feedback loop. No suppressions.
grouping: Provider diagnostics share fixGroupId 881ca7c0052c28ee; Snackbar diagnostics share 68ff2049e5d1d6b7. Infinite scroll is independent.

validation.tests: 11 tests pass across 3 files; three new regressions failed before implementation, and additional preservation tests pass
validation.eslint: Zero errors. One pre-existing set-state-in-effect warning remains in useInfiniteScroll: the observer-driven effect still performs one state update per visibility entry. No suppression added.
validation.limitations: DOM tests use happy-dom, mocked snackbar surfaces/scroll state and mocked preview bridge. No production build or real-browser/provider integration run.
